reviewNotes: Four branches from six pieces after g5 at 94s. Ke5 offers Bf4 and wins after either gxf4 gxf4 (Black must abandon f5) or the selected king move. Bxg5 allows Kxg3 and draws; the representative bishop retreat permits an exchange of White’s last pawn and draws. Earlier ten-piece bishop choice remains source context. Independent representative king retreat and comparison are labeled.
